purpose: Assess whether the completed scientific-integrity branch is suitable to leave draft and become review/merge-ready without changing scientific conclusions, releasing a version, or merging automatically.

examples.rationale: Tests freeze exact retained extraction files, byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes.
Tests require the exact reviewed raw and normalized vintage with raw-to-normalized lineage.
Tests require the exact reviewed AMECO raw ZIPs and normalized actual-only history.

blockers: The PR is too large for complete GitHub diff rendering/review under documented platform limits.
The commit history is larger than GitHub's compare commit-listing limit.
A substantial fraction of the diff is immutable source-vintage provenance that is scientifically retained and should not be deleted merely to reduce review size.
permitted_next_actions: Repair stale public metadata without changing version/tag/release.
Prepare a non-destructive consolidation/splitting strategy that preserves the exact terminal tree and provenance.
Run clean-checkout and scientific CI on any proposed consolidated review series before considering it equivalent.
prohibited_next_actions: Mark PR #47 ready for review solely because CI is green.
Delete retained source vintages solely to make the diff smaller.
Change release/tag/version as part of this gate.
Rewrite scientific boundaries or reopen failed empirical cycles to create a smaller patch.
